name: n8n-code-javascript
description: Write JavaScript in n8n Code nodes; choose modes, access data, and troubleshoot.

## Modes and data
Prefer "Run Once for All Items" for most use cases; use `$input.all()` for aggregation, filtering, sorting, batches, and transformations. Choose "Run Once for Each Item" for independent logic; use `$input.item` or `$item`. Multiple items? "All Items"; independent items? "Each Item". Unsure? "All Items" (you can loop inside).
Access via `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, `$input.item`; specific nodes via `$node["Webhook"].json` or `$node["HTTP Request"].json`. Webhook data is `$json.body`, e.g. `$json.body.name` or `$input.first().json.body`.

## Output
Must return `[{json: {...}}]` format. Always return array of objects with `json` property. Even empty results must use the array/object format. Do not return an object without the array wrapper, an array without `json`, a plain string, raw `$input.all()` without mapping, or `{data: value}`. Next nodes expect this format; invalid output can fail workflow execution. Always include a return statement; all code paths should return a consistent structure.
Example: `return $input.all().map(item => ({json: item.json}));`

## Patterns and guidance
Use `map`/`filter` over manual loops; filter before expensive transformations. Use clear variable names and guard missing/null data with optional chaining/guard clauses (`item.json?.user?.email`).
Do not use n8n expression syntax (`{{ }}`) in Code nodes; use JavaScript directly, e.g. `` `${$json.field}` ``. In other nodes, expressions use `{{ }}`.
Use Code for complex transformations, calculations, business logic, parsing, conditionals, aggregation. Prefer Set for simple field mapping, Filter for basic filtering, IF/Switch for simple conditionals, and HTTP Request for HTTP requests only. Debug with `console.log()` (browser console).

HTTP: `$helpers.httpRequest({url: 'https://api.example.com/data', headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer token', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}})`; return results as `[{json: {data: response}}]`.
Date/time: `DateTime.now()`, `.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd')`, `.toISO()`, `.plus({days: 1})`
